endpoints.name: Management Link
endpoints.description: A self-service portal link for one customer. Requires a customer id. Operational, and short-lived.

endpoints.name: Component by Handle
endpoints.description: One component by handle.

endpoints.name: Product Family Components
endpoints.description: The components available within one family. Requires a family id.

endpoints.name: Product Family Component
endpoints.description: One component within a family.

endpoints.name: Product Family Component by Handle
endpoints.description: One component within a family, by handle.

endpoints.name: Subscription Components
endpoints.description: The components attached to one subscription, with their allocated quantities and prices. Requires a subscription id. What a subscription actually consists of beyond its product.

endpoints.name: Components
endpoints.description: The metered, quantity and on-off components that can be attached to subscriptions -- the usage-based part of a bill, as opposed to the flat product price.

endpoints.name: Subscription Component
endpoints.description: One component on one subscription.

endpoints.name: Subscription Component Usage
endpoints.suffix: /subscriptions/{Subscription ID}/components/{Component ID}/usages.json?since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&max_id={IDs Less Than or Equal To?}&since_date={Since Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&until_date={Until Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}
endpoints.description: The metered usage recorded against one component on one subscription. Requires both ids. THE RAW CONSUMPTION that a usage-based charge is computed from -- the invoice shows the charge, this shows what drove it.

endpoints.name: Subscription Component Allocations
endpoints.description: The history of quantity changes for one component on one subscription. Requires both ids. Upgrades and downgrades within a term are recorded here rather than on the subscription, so seat-count changes are only traceable through this.

endpoints.name: Component Price Points
endpoints.description: The alternative price points of one component. Requires a component id.

endpoints.name: Product Family Coupons
endpoints.description: The coupons within one family. Requires a family id. The gap between list price and realised price is explained here.

endpoints.name: Product Family Coupon
endpoints.description: One coupon within a family.

endpoints.name: Coupon Usage
endpoints.description: How often one coupon has been redeemed, and against which products. Requires a coupon id. Campaign take-up, which the coupon definition does not carry.

endpoints.name: Coupon Search
endpoints.description: Coupons matching criteria across families. The lookup when the family is not known.

endpoints.name: Default Product Family Coupons
endpoints.description: The coupons of the default product family.

endpoints.name: Coupon Subcodes
endpoints.description: The individual codes issued under one coupon. Requires a coupon id. Where a campaign issues unique codes per recipient, redemption is tracked at this level.

endpoints.name: Customers
endpoints.description: The customers, with name, email, organisation, address, the reference from the source system, and their created and updated dates.

endpoints.name: Customer
endpoints.description: One customer by id.

endpoints.name: Customer by Reference
endpoints.description: One customer by the external reference. The lookup from a source-system id.

endpoints.name: Customer Subscriptions
endpoints.description: The subscriptions of one customer. Requires a customer id. One customer can hold several.

endpoints.name: Customer Search
endpoints.description: Customers matching a term across email, id, reference and organisation. The general lookup.

endpoints.name: Subscription Events
endpoints.suffix: /subscriptions/{Subscription ID}/events.json?since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&max_id={IDs Less Than or Equal To?}&filter={Filter?}
endpoints.description: The event history of one subscription since a given id. Requires a subscription id. The per-account lifecycle, and the source for churn timing.

endpoints.name: Events
endpoints.suffix: /events.json?since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&max_id={IDs Less Than or Equal To?}&filter={Filter?}
endpoints.description: Everything that has happened on the site since a given id -- subscription state changes, payments, renewals, component allocations. THE AUDIT TRAIL AND THE INCREMENTAL-SYNC MECHANISM: entity tables carry current state only, so when a subscription changed and what it changed from is answerable here alone.

endpoints.name: Event Count
endpoints.suffix: /events/count.json?since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&max_id={IDs Less Than or Equal To?}&filter={Filter?}
endpoints.description: The number of events matching the filters. The size check before a sync.

endpoints.name: Invoices
endpoints.suffix: /invoices.json?subscription_id={Subscription ID?}&start_date={Start Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&end_date={End Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&status={Status?:draft|open|paid|pending|voided}&line_items={Include Line Items?:true|false}&discounts={Include Discounts?:true|false}&taxes={Include Taxes Data?:true|false}&credits={Include Credits Data?:true|false}&payments={Include Payments Data?:true|false}&custom_fields={Include Custom Fields?:true|false}
endpoints.description: The invoices raised, filterable by subscription and date. Carries the customer, subscription, number, status, totals and line items.

endpoints.name: Invoice
endpoints.description: One invoice by id, with its line items and payments.

endpoints.name: Invoice Payments
endpoints.description: The payments applied to one invoice. Requires an invoice id. The invoice carries a balance; this says when money arrived.

endpoints.name: Invoice Events
endpoints.suffix: /invoices/events.json?since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&since_date={Since Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&invoice_uid={Invoice ID?}
endpoints.description: The events on invoices since a given id -- issued, applied, voided, refunded. The change log for billing documents, and the incremental-sync route for them.

endpoints.name: Credit Notes
endpoints.suffix: /credit_notes.json?subscription_id={Subscription ID?}&line_items={Include Line Items?:true|false}&discounts={Include Discounts?:true|false}&taxes={Include Taxes Data?:true|false}&refunds={Include Credits Data?:true|false}&applications={Include Payments Data?:true|false}
endpoints.description: Credits issued against invoices, filterable by subscription. Revenue net of credits requires this; invoice totals alone overstate it.

endpoints.name: Credit Note
endpoints.description: One credit note by id.

endpoints.name: Notes
endpoints.description: Internal notes on one subscription. Requires a subscription id. Where a human explanation of an unusual account is recorded.

endpoints.name: Note
endpoints.description: One note by id.

endpoints.name: Offers
endpoints.description: The bundled offers defined -- a product plus components and coupons sold as one package. What is actually presented for sale, as opposed to its constituent parts.

endpoints.name: Offer
endpoints.description: One offer by id, with its components.

endpoints.name: Payment Profiles
endpoints.description: The stored payment methods, optionally for one customer. Carries the type, the card's expiry and last four digits, and the gateway. AN EXPIRING CARD IS THE COMMONEST CAUSE OF INVOLUNTARY CHURN and the expiry here is the only place it can be anticipated.

endpoints.name: Payment Profile
endpoints.description: One payment profile by id.

endpoints.name: Products
endpoints.description: The products within one family, with their price, billing period, trial and setup charges. Requires a family id. What subscriptions are sold on.

endpoints.name: Product
endpoints.description: One product by id.

endpoints.name: Product by Handle
endpoints.description: One product by its handle -- the human-readable identifier, more stable than the numeric id across environments.

endpoints.name: Product Price Points
endpoints.description: The alternative price points of one product. Requires a product id. A product can be sold at several prices, so the product's headline price is not necessarily what a given subscription pays.

endpoints.name: Product Price Point
endpoints.description: One product price point by id.

endpoints.name: Product Families
endpoints.description: The product families -- the top-level grouping products, components and coupons belong to. NEARLY EVERYTHING IN CHARGIFY IS SCOPED TO A FAMILY, so this is the first request and a figure taken without regard to family may span unrelated product lines.

endpoints.name: Product Family
endpoints.description: One product family by id.

endpoints.name: Reason Codes
endpoints.description: The cancellation reason codes configured. THE STRUCTURED ANSWER TO WHY CUSTOMERS LEAVE, which the cancellation message alone does not give in analysable form.

endpoints.name: Reason Code
endpoints.description: One reason code by id.

endpoints.name: Validate Referral Code
endpoints.description: Checks whether a referral code is valid. A validation call rather than data.

endpoints.name: Subscription Statement IDs
endpoints.description: The statement ids of one subscription, filterable by settlement date.

endpoints.name: Statement IDs
endpoints.description: The ids of statements settled since a date. The cheap way to find what to fetch rather than paging statements themselves.

endpoints.name: Subscription Statements
endpoints.description: The statements of one subscription. Requires a subscription id.

endpoints.name: Statements
endpoints.description: The billing statements produced. A statement is the period summary sent to a customer, as distinct from an invoice.

endpoints.name: Statement
endpoints.description: One statement by id.

endpoints.name: Stats
endpoints.description: The site's headline figures -- subscription counts by state, revenue this month, and similar. One record of totals, and the cheapest sanity check on any figure derived the long way.

endpoints.name: Subscription
endpoints.description: One subscription by id, with its full state and product detail.

endpoints.name: Subscriptions
endpoints.suffix: /subscriptions.json?state={State?:active|canceled|expired|...}&product={Product ID?}&product_revision_number={Product Revision Number?}&coupon={Coupon ID?}&date_field={Date Field?:current_period_ends_at|current_period_starts_at|...}&start_date={Start Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&end_date={End Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&start_datetime={Start Date Time?:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}&end_datetime={End Date Time?:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}
endpoints.description: The subscriptions on the site, one row each -- the central table. Carries the customer, product, the STATE, current period start and end, activated_at, cancelled_at and the cancellation message, the balance, and any coupon applied. Filterable by state. STATE IS THE FILTER EVERYTHING DEPENDS ON, and Chargify's set is unusually fine: trialing, assessing, active, soft_failure, past_due, canceled, expired, unpaid, on_hold and pending_cancellation. PAST_DUE AND SOFT_FAILURE ARE STILL ACTIVE SUBSCRIPTIONS whose payment failed -- they are the involuntary-churn pipeline, and reading state as a simple active-or-cancelled misses them entirely.

endpoints.name: Subscription by Reference
endpoints.description: One subscription looked up by the reference the source system assigned. The bridge from an external identifier to Chargify's own.

endpoints.name: Transactions
endpoints.suffix: /transactions.json?kinds[]={Transactions Types?,:charge,payment,credit,...}&since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&max_id={IDs Less Than or Equal To?}&since_date={Since Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&until_date={Until Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}
endpoints.description: Payment attempts and their outcomes, filterable by kind. Carries the type, amount, success flag, the gateway response and the subscription. FAILED PAYMENTS EXIST HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE, which is where involuntary churn is diagnosed.

endpoints.name: Transaction
endpoints.description: One transaction by id.

endpoints.name: Subscription Transactions
endpoints.suffix: /subscriptions/{Subscription ID}/transactions.json?kinds[]={Transactions Types?,:charge,payment,credit,...}&since_id={IDs Greater Than or Equal To?}&max_id={IDs Less Than or Equal To?}&since_date={Since Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&until_date={Until Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}
endpoints.description: The transactions of one subscription, filterable by kind. Requires a subscription id. The per-account payment history.

endpoints.name: Transaction Count
endpoints.description: The number of transactions matching the filters, without returning them. The cheap size check before an extract.

endpoints.name: Webhooks
endpoints.description: The webhook deliveries attempted, filterable by date and status. NOT configuration: this is the delivery log, so a silently broken integration is visible here.
